definitions.latest: Publishedの新しい順。Published同値はFirst Seenの新しい順。
definitions.hottest: 直近30日Publishedの記事を現在Heatの高い順。
definitions.rising: Heat履歴2点以上・6時間以上のspanが揃った記事を対象に、直近24時間のHeat上昇率で算出。
definitions.persistent_hot: Heat履歴3点以上・48時間以上のspanが揃った記事を対象に、各時点で上位10%を80%以上維持した記事。

latest.title: Cisco Informational for Emergency Distrust of eMudhra Root and Intermediate Certificate Authorities
latest.summary_excerpt: Between October 17 and October 20, 2026, a critical security compromise involving Certificate Authorities that are managed by eMudhra was uncovered. A security researcher demonstrated that the private keys for eight eMudhra intermediate certificates were fundamentally broken due to an unprecedented error in their Key Generation Ceremony (KGC) in April 2025. This allows anyone to brute-force acquire these private keys within seconds.
